gaps.lead: He finally succeeded in solving the puzzle.
gaps.explanation: manage to do = be able to do.

gaps.lead: Nobody can say that he doesn't work hard.
The athlete insisted that she had never taken banned substances.
gaps.explanation: deny having + past participle denies an earlier action.

gaps.lead: I have never heard such a ridiculous excuse.
gaps.explanation: Fronted 'never' forces inversion: Never have I heard…

gaps.lead: It would be unwise for you to complain to the manager directly.
gaps.explanation: 'It would be unwise' = 'you had better not' — had better + not + bare infinitive.

gaps.lead: It would be sensible to leave before the traffic builds up.
gaps.sentence: We ___ before the traffic builds up.
gaps.explanation: 'It would be sensible to do' = 'we had better do' — had better + bare infinitive.
